ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the food web diagram shown, what does the shrew consume directly?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The food web diagram has a box labeled 'shrew' near the lower right. A direct arrow runs from the box labeled 'earthworm' into the 'shrew' box. Reasoning: In this food web, an arrow from organism A to organism B means B directly consumes A. Since the arrow points from earthworm to shrew, the shrew directly consumes the earthworm.
